ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.procedure_code != :vpg_block.procedure_code or
 :global.procedure_group != :vpg_block.procedure_group then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :global.procedure_code||','||
 :global.procedure_group||','|| 
 ',','D',chk); 
 
 end if;
IF :global.procedure_code = :vpg_block.procedure_code and
 :global.procedure_group = :vpg_block.procedure_group 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :vpg_block.procedure_code is not null and
 :vpg_block.procedure_group is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_proc_groups
 WHERE procedure_code = :vpg_block.procedure_code and
 procedure_group = :vpg_block.procedure_group;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vpg_block.procedure_code||','||
 :vpg_block.procedure_group||','|| 
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319'); 
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vpg_block.procedure_code||','||
 :vpg_block.procedure_group||','|| 
 ',','U',chk); 

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates(eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2) IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 v_sysdate date; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');

 --if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if eff_date < trunc(v_sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date, term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 end if;
 
 --if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if term_date < trunc(v_sysdate) then -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_insert_rg(plGrp in varchar2,plProc in varchar2, 
 plEDate in varchar2,plTDate in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPG'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPG.PGRP'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPG.CODE';
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPG.EDATE'; 
 rg_col4 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPG.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
 DUP_RECORD VARCHAR2(1):='N';
 VCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VPG');
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plGrp AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plProc AND 
 to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') is not null AND 
 ( to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') is null or 
 --to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') > trunc(sysdate)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 nvl(to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy'), to_date(plEDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY')) between to_date(plEDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY') and nvl(to_date(plTDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY'), nvl(to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy'), to_date(plEDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY')))) -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 then
 DUP_RECORD:='Y'; 
 exit; 
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 If DUP_RECORD ='Y' then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else

 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, plGrp); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, plProc); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, plEDATE); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col4, rowcount+1, plTDATE); 
 --message('Record Inserted');pause; 
 End if;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DB_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--FUNCTION db_check (plGrp in varchar2,plProc in varchar2,plEDATE in date) RETURN BOOLEAN IS -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
FUNCTION db_check (plGrp in varchar2, plProc in varchar2, plEDATE in date, plTDATE in date) RETURN BOOLEAN IS -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 vCount NUMBER := 0;
 vDupCnt number := 0; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
BEGIN
 synchronize; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from valid_proc_groups where
 procedure_group = plGrp and procedure_code = plProc and
 (term_date is null OR term_date > plEDATE );
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if :system.trigger_item = 'VPG_BLOCK.EFF_DATE' then
 select count(*)
 into vCount
 from valid_proc_groups 
 where procedure_group = plGrp 
 and procedure_code = plProc
 and plEDATE between eff_date and nvl(term_date, plEDATE);
 else
 select nvl(count(*), 0) 
 into vCount
 from valid_proc_groups 
 where procedure_group = plGrp 
 and procedure_code = plProc
 and nvl(plTDATE, eff_date) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, nvl(plTDATE, eff_date));
 end if;
 
 select count(*)
 into vDupCnt
 from valid_proc_groups 
 where procedure_group = plGrp 
 and procedure_code = plProc;
 -- End of change

 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 --IF vCount > 0 then -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 IF vDupCnt > 0 then -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 RETURN (TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN (FALSE);
 END IF;
 else -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 IF vCount > 1 then
 RETURN (TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN (FALSE);
 END IF;
 -- End of change
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
END;

FUNCTION check_existing_data RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 v_grp VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_group));
 v_proc VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_code));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN
 If NVL(:vpg_block.procedure_group,'') = NVL(v_grp,'') AND
 NVL(:vpg_block.procedure_code,'') = NVL(v_proc,'') AND
 NVL(:vpg_block.eff_date,'') = nvl(v_date,'' ) AND
 NVL(:vpg_block.term_date,'') = nvl(v_tdate ,'') THEN
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return (False);
 End if; 
END;

 -- End of change

 If not check_existing_data then
 --If :vpg_block.term_date is null or :vpg_block.term_date > sysdate then -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if :vpg_block.term_date is null or :vpg_block.term_date > v_sysdate then -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 --If db_check(:vpg_block.procedure_group,:vpg_block.procedure_code, -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 -- nvl(trunc(:vpg_block.eff_date),trunc(sysdate))) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 if db_check(:vpg_block.procedure_group, :vpg_block.procedure_code, -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 nvl(trunc(:vpg_block.eff_date), trunc(v_sysdate)), :vpg_block.term_date) -- Added by Kishore on 04/13/2015. SCR 21369
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 
 If NVL(:vpg_block.procedure_group,'') !=NVL(v_grp,'') OR
 NVL(:vpg_block.procedure_code,'') !=NVL(v_proc,'') OR
 NVL(:vpg_block.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then 
 --message('Delete Grp='||v_grp||' PR='||:vpg_block.procedure_group||' ED='||to_char(:vpg_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')||
 --'TD='||to_char(:vpg_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));pause;
 
 DUP_DELETE_RG(nvl(v_grp,:vpg_block.procedure_group),nvl(v_proc,:vpg_block.procedure_code),
 nvl(to_char(v_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),to_char(:vpg_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')),
 to_char(v_tdate));
 
 End if; 
 -- message('Grp='||:vpg_block.procedure_group||' PR='||:vpg_block.procedure_code||
 --' ED='||to_char(:vpg_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')||
 --'TD='||to_char(:vpg_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));pause;
 
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:vpg_block.procedure_group,:vpg_block.procedure_code,
 to_char(:vpg_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),to_char(:vpg_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));
 End if; 
 End if;
 End if;
End if;
END;
